The execution failed because the required output file '/root/project_proposal_ready.hwpx' was not created.
The test suite failed with multiple FileNotFoundError and AssertionError messages because OUTPUT_FILE.exists() returned False. Specifically, zipfile.ZipFile(hwpx_path) raised 'FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory' when attempting to open the expected HWPX result. Tests 'test_output_exists_and_is_zip', 'test_required_values_present_and_placeholders_removed', and 'test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache' all failed due to this missing artifact.
